action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate c4b5 at full depth to obtain commit-ready evidence.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search flagged c4b5 as the top exact-scoring move (140), and the reserve protects it for single-candidate verification. Pawn takes b5 removing a pawn; recapture axb5 then f1d3 develops the bishop. Need single-candidate verification at effective depth 4 with safety probes before committing.
